signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: ew 153329, 3/5] Not all features work and support is not helpful: I got this free deal, then paid them for the upgraded unlimited sites

Each site scan credit is valid for one successful site scan; if we can’t access the site or perform the scan for any reason no credits will be deducted from your account

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 3 reviews (1.1% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: Sent them an email about this a while back and they never even bothered to reply.
I have reported to them but its been a week and still no update from them.
I did not have a good support experience while trying to get help to solve this issue.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 7.6 years old. Sold on AppSumo once before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $49 vs a stated $158 regular price (69% off).

License Tier 1: $49 (was $158)

claims.text: Scan site for broken or dangerous links and set up automatic redirects with centralized dashboard

quote.text: WP 301 Redirects lets you scan your site for broken or dangerous links and set up automatic redirects, manage affiliate links, and control all your sites from a centralized dashboard.

claims.text: Link Scanner catches broken URLs and disreputable outlinks

quote.text: With the WP 301 Redirects Link Scanner tool, you'll be able to catch broken URLs and disreputable outlinks before you lose visitors to competitor pages.

claims.text: Automatically scan links for every page for broken or bad links

quote.text: The link-scanning tool is SaaS-integrated, so you can automatically scan links for every page in case of broken ones that need replacing, or bad ones that need removing.

claims.text: Google Safe Browsing and Alexa Rank API integrations to filter poor reputation links

quote.text: Plus, the Google Safe Browsing and Alexa Rank API integrations let you sort through content for links to sites with a poor reputation or malware.

claims.text: Mistyped URLs automatically redirected to similar URL

quote.text: For broken internal links, simply install the WP 301 Redirects plugin and all those mistyped URLs will be automatically redirected to the page with a similar URL.

claims.text: Export branded PDF reports to send to clients

quote.text: You can even export branded PDF reports to send to clients and show off all your hard work on fixing errors for their site.

claims.text: Remotely monitor sites, redirects and 404 logs without logging into individual sites

quote.text: WP 301 Redirects lets you remotely monitor sites, sites’ redirects, and 404 logs, plus perform remote actions without having to log in to individual sites.

claims.text: Fully customize and rebrand the plugin without coding

quote.text: You’ll even be able to fully customize and rebrand the plugin without any coding through brand-specific logos, plugin names, company names, URLs, and contact info that match your business.

trials.claimQuote: Get lifetime access to WP 301 Redirects today!
trials.reasoning: The binding terms reserve the right to remove inactive free accounts after a year and permanently delete accounts not activated by March 15th 2021, materially limiting the unconditional lifetime promise despite the marketing statements.

exhibits.quote: If you do not login to your free account for more than a year, and don’t have any active sites connected, we’ll consider it to be inactive and reserve the right to remove the account
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is not unconditional because the vendor reserves the right to delete inactive freebie accounts after a year of no login.

exhibits.quote: All freebie accounts must be redeemed and fully activated by March 15th 2021, those that are not activated by that date will be permanently deleted
exhibits.argument: Lifetime claim is limited by a hard redemption deadline after which accounts are permanently deleted.

exhibits.quote: No yearly fees! Pay once and use forever!
exhibits.argument: This vendor statement directly promises lifetime access with a one-time payment, supporting the lifetime access claim.

exhibits.quote: The freebie tier distributed by AppSumo is a lifetime license valid for 10 sites. No strings attached.
exhibits.argument: The vendor's own terms confirm the AppSumo deal is a lifetime license, corroborating lifetime access.

trials.claim: Tier 1 limited to 20 sites and 5 full site scans per month
trials.claimQuote:
- 20 sites
- 5 full site scans per month
- White labeling
- License and site manager (remote dashboard)
trials.reasoning: The vendor's terms define the AppSumo freebie tier as a lifetime license valid for 10 sites, directly conflicting with the claimed Tier 1 limit of 20 sites.

exhibits.quote: * 1 Site * 30 Site Scans * All Plugin Features * Licenses & Sites Manager * Remote Site Stats & Logs
exhibits.argument: Official pricing lists Personal as 1 site and 30 scans, not 20 sites and 5 scans as claimed for Tier 1.

exhibits.quote: The freebie tier distributed by AppSumo is a lifetime license valid for 10 sites. No strings attached.
exhibits.argument: Terms define the AppSumo freebie as 10 sites, contradicting the 20 sites limit described in the claim.

trials.claim: Regular price was $158, deal price $49 for Tier 1
trials.claimQuote:
License Tier 1: $49 (was $158)
- Lifetime access to WP 301 Redirects
- All future Team Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The vendor's own pricing shows the lifetime license was $79, not the claimed $158 regular price, while the deal price is $49.

exhibits.quote: $79 $49 Lifetime License * 1 Site * 30 Site Scans * All Plugin Features * Licenses & Sites Manager
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own pricing shows Personal tier was $79 not $158, contradicting the claimed regular price.

exhibits.quote: We do not have any price-lock-in guarantees. If you buy for $10 today and see a deal for $5 tomorrow we won’t refund you $5 nor upgrade your account
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims any price guarantee, undermining the advertised was/now saving claim.

trials.claim: Scan site for broken or dangerous links and set up automatic redirects with centralized dashboard
trials.claimQuote: WP 301 Redirects lets you scan your site for broken or dangerous links and set up automatic redirects, manage affiliate links, and control all your sites from a centralized dashboard.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the Link Checker was not working and the 404 redirection failed with common page builders and themes, materially undercutting the claimed scanning and automatic redirect functionality beyond the vendor's marketing description.

exhibits.quote: Also the entire reason I purchased the plugin was for "Link Checker" which isn't working, I have reported to them but its been a week and still no update
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the core link scanning feature did not work, contradicting the scan and redirect promise.

exhibits.quote: The 404 redirection feature (which was the main reason I purchased their upgrade) doesn't work with 2 page builders I use, as well as at least 2 themes
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports automatic 404 redirection fails on common page builders and themes, undermining the centralized dashboard claim.

exhibits.quote: Quickly check every outgoing link on your site to determine if it’s broken or leading to malicious sites.
exhibits.argument: This vendor description confirms the ability to scan for broken or dangerous links as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Centralized Dashboard Control all your licenses, sites, logs, and brands from a single location. Easily accessible and controllable.
exhibits.argument: This vendor text confirms the centralized dashboard for managing sites, supporting that part of the claim.

trials.claim: Link Scanner catches broken URLs and disreputable outlinks
trials.claimQuote: With the WP 301 Redirects Link Scanner tool, you'll be able to catch broken URLs and disreputable outlinks before you lose visitors to competitor pages.
trials.reasoning: The reviews directly conflict: one buyer says the scanner missed all URL changes and was not working, while another says it successfully found broken and SEO-harmful links, leaving the claim unresolved.

exhibits.quote: WP 301 Redirects has so far missed all URL changes I have made. Also the entire reason I purchased the plugin was for "Link Checker" which isn't working
exhibits.argument: Review shows Link Scanner missed URL changes and did not work, contradicting that it catches broken URLs.

exhibits.quote: Then I learned how to use Google Search Console, which should me hundreds of pages could not be indexed because they had 301 redirects.
exhibits.argument: Review reports the plugin created hundreds of unwanted 301 redirects that harmed SEO instead of catching bad outlinks.

exhibits.quote: Quickly check every outgoing link on your site to determine if it’s broken or leading to malicious sites.
exhibits.argument: This vendor quote directly states the Link Scanner checks for broken and malicious outlinks, matching the claim.

exhibits.quote: It helps to find broken links and links to URLs that have a negative effect on my SEO - great work as always!
exhibits.argument: This buyer review confirms the Link Scanner successfully catches broken and disreputable outlinks in practice.

trials.claim: Automatically scan links for every page for broken or bad links
trials.claimQuote: The link-scanning tool is SaaS-integrated, so you can automatically scan links for every page in case of broken ones that need replacing, or bad ones that need removing.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states it checks every outgoing link for broken or malicious sites and a buyer confirms the scanner identified links to remove; the 50,000-scan monthly cap does not contradict scanning every page because the claim does not promise unlimited scans.

exhibits.quote: There is no limit on the number of pages or links on a site, but we do have a monthly limit of 50,000 link scans; if you cross that limit contact support
exhibits.argument: Automatic scanning is capped at 50,000 link scans per month, contradicting unlimited automatic scanning for every page.

exhibits.quote: Each site scan credit is valid for one successful site scan; if we can’t access the site or perform the scan for any reason no credits will be deducted
exhibits.argument: Scans consume limited credits per site and require successful access, so scanning is not automatic and unlimited.

exhibits.quote: Quickly check every outgoing link on your site to determine if it’s broken or leading to malicious sites.
exhibits.argument: This vendor statement supports automatically scanning every page's links for broken or bad links.

exhibits.quote: In my case, the scanner showed me a number of links that I needed to remove. Amazing if you are not a huge techie like me.
exhibits.argument: This buyer review confirms the scanner automatically identified bad links across the site needing removal.
